nodes.text: And mice by day, tossing their straw bedding with their feet,
long for their bed, when [the sky] shows signs of rain.
Make light of none of these; it is good, sign upon sign,
to look out; and when two point to the same thing, the more
hope there would be, and with a third you may be confident.
And always, as the year goes by, you should count
the signs, comparing whether perhaps at a star's
rising or setting such a dawn shines forth
as the sign too would indicate; and it would be very useful
to note, of the waning and the beginning month,
both fourth days; for they, of months meeting together,
